dct_description_sm:
Zones used for the Sign bylaw. Prior to starting any stage of your project, including erecting signage, you must obtain a permit. This dataset is updated manually as needed.

Please refer to our website for more information about Signage: https://www.victoria.ca/EN/main/residents/planning-development/permits-inspections/signage.html

The "Last Updated" date shown on our Open Data Portal refers to the last time the data schema was modified in the portal, or any changes were made to this description.  We update our data through automated scripts which does not trigger the "last updated" date to change.

Note: Attributes represent each field in a dataset, and some fields will contain information such as ID numbers.  As a result some visualizations on the tabs on our Open Data page will not be relevant.
schema_provider_s: City of Victoria Open Data Portal
